text: Unity names one folder 'Do Not Ship It With Your Game.' This demo shipped it.
It is 1.6 of the 2.2 gigabytes you download.
Frontier Tale is a cozy farming game with extraction runs. 219 people are in the demo now.
The game itself is 615 megabytes. The rest is that folder.
Inside: 577 C++ files, their whole game translated out of C#.
And 88 debug symbol files. One is 688 megabytes by itself.
IL2CPP hides what a team used. This build lists it: A* Pathfinding, FMOD, Cinemachine.
So check your build folder before you upload. Unity already told you which one. This is Demo Dip.
